ideas.title: Lightning makes magnets
ideas.goal: before a storm the player plants iron spikes upright on the cliff top; when lightning strikes one, the bolt's current magnetises everything near its path, and next morning the player goes round with the compass bowl finding out what they made: the struck spike a strong magnet, the near ones weak, the far ones nothing, the ones planted crooked magnetised crooked. Where you plant decides what you get, so you come back every storm
ideas.toward: where the island's magnets come from, made by the player instead of found: the stone road gets a source of magnets, and em.jl's current field (Biot-Savart of the bolt) and a remanence law are both used for real
ideas.idea: the island's storm already throws lightning; the bolt picks its path by height and what conducts (the tallest iron wins), it carries tens of kiloamperes for microseconds, its field at each spike is solved from the bolt's path, and each spike keeps a remanence by its iron's hysteresis curve and its angle to the field. Someone watching sees the strike, the spikes standing in rain, and in the morning a spike that drags itself to the compass
ideas.form: a storm interaction published to the human's game; a traced film at night: the strike lit by the bolt itself, then the morning test

ideas.title: Read the sand, find the stone
ideas.goal: magnet stones lie buried at random under the beach. The player sprinkles black iron sand, taps the ground, and the grains stand into the hidden field: a ring of bristles over one stone, two lobes over a stone lying on its side, a wall between two that face each other. From the pattern the player reads where to dig, how deep and which way round the stone lies, then digs it out to check
ideas.toward: the island's way to see any field, which every later magnet and coil will use, and a check of em.jl against the textbook patterns, played as a reading puzzle instead of shown as a picture
ideas.idea: a few thousand grains as soft-iron dipoles on the GPU (a Mantle kernel): each feels the buried stones' field and its neighbours' dipoles, friction holds it until a tap lifts it, and grains chain end to end along the lines. The digging is the shovel the island has. Someone watching sees grey dust become a map of something nobody can see, and then the stone come out of the sand exactly under it
ideas.form: a beach puzzle with a key card, published; a top-down traced film of the sand rising and the dig

ideas.title: An iron tree on the stone
ideas.goal: the player sets spikes one by one onto the magnet stone: each stands on end along the field, the next one hangs from its tip, and a bristling iron tree grows. Put a spike where the field is weak and the branch sags and the tree falls apart; the skill is to read where the field still holds and build the tallest tree before it topples
ideas.toward: road step 'iron magnetises iron': spikes solved together (physics/softiron.jl), each one a magnet for the next, so the tree's shape is the field's, and it breaks by force where the field gives out
ideas.idea: softiron.jl inside plugins/magnetstone.jl: every spike's induced magnetisation is solved with all the others, contacts hold while the field's pull beats gravity and the lever of the branch, and the tree collapses spike by spike when one joint fails. Someone watching sees iron grow upward out of a stone like a frozen splash, then a shower of spikes
ideas.form: a stacking game at the north beach with a height record, published; a close film with the tree at least half the frame height

ideas.title: Stroke a needle into a compass
ideas.goal: the player strokes an iron needle along the magnet stone with the beak, always the same way: each stroke leaves the needle a little more magnetic, a stroke the wrong way undoes some of it, and a needle dropped or heated forgets. Floated on its lily pad in the bowl, it turns to north as hard as the player made it. The game is learning to make a good one
ideas.toward: magnets the player makes from iron by hand, with real hysteresis: the first part fitted by the beak, and the needle the later circuits are measured with
ideas.idea: a remanence model per needle segment (a Preisach or Jiles-Atherton curve) driven by the field each part of the needle sees as the stone slides along it; the needle's moment then drives the compass bowl that already floats by the solver. Someone watching sees Lumi stroke, stroke, test, and the needle swing round
ideas.form: an interaction at the compass bowl with key card, published; a close film of the beak, needle and bowl
